about: The survival plan on the map (docs/SURVIVAL.md): what's in the game now, what's part-built and what's still to build, act by act. Drawn over world/lawn/layout.json by tools/survival_map.py into docs/narrative/survival-map.html. Update the statuses here as things get built, then re-run it.
title: Survival: the garden, built and to build
sub: Survival mode's plan (docs/SURVIVAL.md) drawn over today's garden (world/lawn/layout.json). Solid pins are in the game, half pins are part-built, hollow pins are still to build. Hover a pin for what's there.

zooms.title: The apple tree: its grounds, its caves, the climb and the Rootway

layers.name: Act 1: the lawn, the gate, the kingdom
Act 2 far: over the Rut to the patio edge
Act 3: the patio and the Citadel

next: Act 1's found story (SURVIVAL.md build step 5): the cracked vial and his first thought where he wakes, the ants' trail, the coin, the first raid at the Colony Gate, and the gate opening into the kingdom, where the Queen sets the goal (and wants the golden thread).
The blackbird on Leaf-Litter Moor: dry leaves crunch, noise brings it (the model is ready).
The Rootway behind the West Root Door (a Blender re-bake) and the Maw.
The termite front; the wolf spider and Sky-Salt; Act 3.

regions.name: the tree grounds
regions.note: Built: its own ground, thin shade grass, drifts of last year's leaves, windfalls, roots, a fallen branch and puddles along the drip line

regions.name: the canopy (520 m up)
regions.note: Only a picture in the sky today (the Old Bough, 140 m up, is built). To build: the crown itself, the Musketeers' Old Camp

regions.name: the patio (18 m up)
regions.note: Built for the old get-home game: slabs, the trowel ramp, the brush, the step and the back door

routes.name: the ants' trail to the gate
the first raid: along the kerb top

pins.name: He wakes
pins.note: Built: he wakes by his school bag with the stone knife. To add: the cracked vial with the ants' marks, and his first thought ('Did... ants do this?')

pins.name: Crisp packet
pins.note: A shelter to sleep in; the hammer lies in it; its foil is the wolf spider's mirror later

pins.name: Capstone
pins.note: A shelter to sleep in, and the lookout blade over the lawn

pins.name: Night beetles
pins.note: Ground beetles come out at dusk from four homes, hunt him down, and go back at dawn

pins.name: Ladybirds
pins.note: Win one over with bug meat; it follows, comes to Q, and with a leaf saddle he rides it

pins.name: The coin
pins.note: The ants' 'Brass Moon' in the plaza: he knows coins roll, and it breaks the raiders' line

pins.name: Colony Gate
pins.note: Built: the gate. To add: guards who won't let him in, and the gate opening after the first raid

pins.name: The kingdom
pins.note: Under the Bare Patch: the hub. A safe bed, trade, the Queen (model ready) and her three ingredients; the ants teach the raft

pins.name: Kerb stair
pins.note: Where the raiders come down off the driveway kerb (a few stones)

pins.name: Sap Falls
pins.note: A bark wound: sap drops by hand, clumps with the hammer, for resin and the first torch

pins.name: Windfall Orchard
pins.note: Apples to eat, rotting ones with fruit flies

pins.name: Leaf-Litter Moor
pins.note: Built: the dry leaves. To add: they crunch, and noise brings a blackbird turning the litter (model ready)

pins.name: Drip-line puddles
pins.note: Water to drink round the tree

pins.name: Root Hall
pins.note: The caves inside the trunk base: the hall, the grub burrow and nest. A shelter to sleep in

pins.name: Knot-hole ledge
pins.note: Built: the Heartwood Stair climbs inside the trunk to a ledge 60 m up (a mission step). To add: something to find there

pins.name: The Old Bough
pins.note: A pruned limb 140 m up the west side: the weavers' landing, the silk ladder hung from it, a water shoot, the orb weaver's web above

pins.name: Silk ladder
pins.note: Hung from the weavers' landing on the Old Bough, 140 m up: about 30 s up at a sprint

pins.name: The orb weaver
pins.note: Great beast. It sits at the hub of its web, out of reach. Cut a guy line and it comes down to mend it; cut all three first and the web falls with it. On the bark it bites (it crouches first) and flings silk. Beaten, it leaves the golden thread

pins.name: West Root Door
pins.note: Built: a dark gap under a root. To add: the Rootway behind it (today a wall)

pins.name: The Maw
pins.note: Great beast, a giant centipede under the root crossing: herd it with torchlight, stamp over the pit, heave the boulder. Moonroot sap. Model ready

pins.name: The Maw's hole
pins.note: Where the Rootway's south fork comes up in Windfall Roots

pins.name: The Rut
pins.note: Drink here, swim, fill the flask; the leaf raft crosses it

pins.name: Windfall Roots
pins.note: Fallen apples and an apple core: food

pins.name: The wolf spider
pins.note: Built: its burrow, its trip lines, the spider lurking. To add: the puzzle (pluck the line, heave a stone into the burrow, dazzle it with foil)

pins.name: Sky-Salt
pins.note: A sugar crystal from a spilt drink on the patio edge: the third ingredient (model ready)

pins.name: Silent outpost
pins.note: The old ant outpost on the south shore (scenery for now)

pins.name: Three burrows
pins.note: Plugged with casts until the first rain washes them open; worms come up in the rain

pins.name: The Great Worm
pins.note: Its lair, the old shaft to heave open, daylight to lure it through; the Wormways' missions

pins.name: Termite works
pins.note: Built: the forward camp and the mud-tube tower (tubes smash with the hammer). To add: tubes that creep, wood eaten, raids at dusk, pushing them back

pins.name: The Citadel
pins.note: The termites' woodpile against the house: Akpuru and their queen (models ready). The end

pins.name: Back door
pins.note: From the old get-home game; a look at home (he can't go yet)

tree_missions.title: The Old Tree
steps: Break sap off the tree's roots or at Sap Falls, for resin

tree_missions.title: The Heartwood Stair
steps: Light your torch in the dark
Find the way up inside the trunk

tree_missions.title: The Weavers' Ladder
steps: Find the silk ladder on the west side
Climb it to the Old Bough
Look up: something lives over the bough

tree_missions.title: The Orb Weaver
steps: Cut a guy line holding the web down
Cut all three before it mends them
Beat it on the bark, where it's clumsy

tree_missions_title: In the game: the apple tree's missions (world/lawn/tree_missions.json)
